project.name: MOBA-TEngine
project.description: MOBA game project built on TEngine framework (HybridCLR + YooAsset + UniTask + Luban). Includes game logic, skill graph editor, network/authentication, and game server.

nodes.name: AssemblyHelper.cs
nodes.summary: 静态工具类，负责加载 Entity 程序集和 Hotfix 热重载程序集，支持通过 AssemblyLoadContext 动态卸载和重载 Hotfix.dll。

nodes.name: AssemblyHelper
nodes.summary: 静态类，提供 Initialize、LoadEntityAssembly、LoadHotfixAssembly 方法，管理服务端程序集的加载与热重载。

nodes.name: LoadHotfixAssembly
nodes.summary: 卸载旧的 AssemblyLoadContext，从磁盘读取 Hotfix.dll 和 .pdb，加载到新的可卸载上下文中并触发 ModuleInitializer。

nodes.name: AuthenticationComponent.cs
nodes.summary: 鉴权组件实体，持有注册账号的内存缓存字典，键为账号标识，值为 Account 实体。

nodes.name: AccountTimeOutComponent
nodes.summary: 继承 Fantasy.Entitas.Entity，字段 TimeId 存储定时器 ID。

nodes.name: LockType.cs
nodes.summary: 定义服务端分布式锁类型枚举，包含鉴权注册锁和鉴权登录锁。

nodes.name: C2A_LoginRequestHandler.cs
nodes.summary: 处理客户端登录请求的 RPC Handler，调用 AuthenticationHelper.Login 并将结果写入响应，登录成功后向客户端推送欢迎消息。

nodes.name: C2A_LoginRequestHandler
nodes.summary: 继承 MessageRPC<C2A_LoginRequest, A2C_LoginResponse>，Run 方法调用 AuthenticationHelper.Login 处理登录逻辑。

nodes.name: C2A_RegisterRequestHandler.cs
nodes.summary: 处理客户端注册请求的 RPC Handler，调用 AuthenticationHelper.Register 并将错误码写入响应。

nodes.name: C2A_RegisterRequestHandler
nodes.summary: 继承 MessageRPC<C2A_RegisterRequest, A2C_RegisterResponse>，Run 方法调用 AuthenticationHelper.Register 处理注册逻辑。

nodes.name: OnSceneCreate_Init.cs
nodes.summary: Fantasy.Net 场景创建事件处理器，根据 SceneType 为 Authentication 场景挂载 AuthenticationComponent，为 Gate 场景打印启动日志。

nodes.name: OnSceneCreate_Init
nodes.summary: 异步事件系统处理器，监听 OnCreateScene 事件，按场景类型初始化对应组件。

nodes.name: Handler

nodes.name: AuthenticationComponentSystem.cs
nodes.summary: 鉴权组件的扩展方法系统，提供 Login 和 Register 两个异步操作，使用协程锁保证并发安全，并与数据库交互完成账号管理。

nodes.name: Login

nodes.name: AuthenticationHelper

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: GameApp.cs is the hotfix entry point that initializes all game modules. GameModule.cs provides static accessors to all registered modules via GameModule.XXX pattern, serving as the central service locator.

tour.title: UI Framework Foundation
tour.description: UIBase is the abstract base class for all UI elements. UIWindow represents full-screen windows, UIWidget represents reusable sub-components. UIModule manages the lifecycle of all UI windows including creation, showing, hiding, and destruction.

tour.title: UI Widget Components
tour.description: Reusable UI widget components for lists, grids, and event items. UIListBase provides base list functionality, while UILoopListWidget and UILoopGridWidget implement virtualized scrolling for performance. These widgets compose into complex UI layouts.

tour.title: Page Switching System
tour.description: SwitchPageMgr manages tab-based page navigation within UI windows. BaseChildPage defines the interface for child pages, and SwitchTabItem handles individual tab button behavior. This enables complex multi-tab interfaces.

tour.title: Concrete UI Screens
tour.description: LoginUI handles the login screen with authentication flow. BattleMainUI is the main battle HUD. CommonUIController provides shared UI control logic. These demonstrate how to build screens using the UI framework.

tour.title: Network & Data Center
tour.description: DataCenterModule and DataCenterSys manage client-server data synchronization. GameClient handles the network connection lifecycle. ClientConnectWatcher monitors connection state and handles reconnection. LoginNetMgr processes login-specific network messages.

tour.title: Singleton System
tour.description: SingletonSystem provides a managed singleton lifecycle with automatic creation and destruction. Singleton<T> is for pure C# singletons, SingletonBehaviour<T> for MonoBehaviour-based singletons. This avoids the common Unity singleton anti-patterns.

tour.title: Skill Graph Editor
tour.description: SkillGraphEditor is the main EditorWindow for visual skill graph editing. SkillGraphView renders the graph canvas. SkillGraphNode represents individual nodes. SkillGraphNodeFactory creates node instances. The editor supports undo, search, and blackboard variable management.

tour.title: Skill Graph Node Types
tour.description: The editor defines several node types: ActionNode for skill actions, BranchNode for flow branching, ConditionNode for conditional logic, DelayNode for timing, DebugNode for debugging, and SetVariableNode for blackboard manipulation. EntryNode marks the graph start.

tour.title: Skill Graph Export & Data
tour.description: SkillGraphExporter converts the editor graph into runtime JSON format. SkillGraphData, SkillNodeData, and SkillEdgeData define the serializable data structures. This bridges the editor and runtime skill systems.

tour.title: Skill Graph Runtime Engine
tour.description: SkillGraphRunner is the core runtime engine that executes skill graphs with step-based processing and snapshot/restore support. RuntimeSkillGraph defines the runtime data model. SkillContext holds execution state. SkillHandlers implement the actual skill behaviors.

tour.title: Skill Graph Client Integration
tour.description: SkillExecutor bridges the runtime skill graph engine to the Unity game client. SkillGraphAnimancerPlayer integrates with the Animancer animation system to play skill animations. These connect the shared runtime to the client-side game logic.

tour.title: Game Server Architecture
tour.description: The server uses Fantasy framework with Entity/Hotfix separation. Program.cs is the entry point. AuthenticationComponentSystem handles login/register logic. Request handlers process client messages. The server shares protocol definitions with the client.
